name: crafillio-devkit
description: API Devkit — an offline-first API workbench for REST, gRPC and S3, with built-in load testing.
author: Amit Singh

scripts.build: npm run build -w @crafillio/core && npm run build -w @crafillio/ui
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @crafillio/desktop
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @crafillio/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core apps/desktop && npm run typecheck -w @crafillio/ui
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @crafillio/desktop
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist apps/*/dist apps/desktop/release packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo apps/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run licenses && npm run audit
